metadata.description: Development tooling for Claude Code — Swift/iOS workflows, git branch topology, and language-agnostic code intelligence (routing, LSP servers, per-stack setup)

plugins.name: code-intel
plugins.description: Routes code-navigation questions to the right tool — LSP/serena for exact references, semantic graphs for concept search, ast-grep/semgrep for structural patterns, grep for constants and completeness — with per-stack setup guides, a propose-then-apply setup command, and a doctor

plugins.name: code-intel-lsp
plugins.description: Four language servers in one togglable plugin — typescript-language-server, basedpyright, clangd, sourcekit-lsp. Diagnostics off; servers start lazily on the first LSP tool call and are skipped when their binary is absent

plugins.name: ferry
plugins.description: Physical iPad/iPhone workflows via the ferry CLI — deploy, device selection, lock detection, iOS 26.4-safe log capture, LogBrook run access, live rerun bridge, container file transfer

plugins.name: dryad
plugins.description: Git branch topology via the dryad CLI — parent-branch inference, fork points, the branch forest with worktree locations, and a safe parents-before-children merge order

plugins.name: swift-cxx-interop
plugins.description: Swift 6 / C++ interoperability — importing C++ types into Swift, SWIFT_SHARED_REFERENCE, lifetime annotations, std::span safe interop, std::string bridging, cv::Mat patterns, and Swift-to-C++ export
